doc_name: What We Do in the Shadows (TV series)
text: What We Do in the Shadows is an American comedy horror mockumentary fantasy television series created by Jemaine Clement, which first aired on FX on March 27, 2019, and concluded its run with the end of its sixth season on December 16, 2024. The series is based on the 2014 New Zealand film written and directed by Clement and Taika Waititi, both of whom serve as executive producers and appear in the show. It follows four vampire roommates—Nandor, Laszlo, Nadja, and energy vampire Colin Robinson—living on Staten Island, with their residence maintained by Nandor's familiar, Guillermo. The vampires frequently clash with the modern world, other supernatural beings, and each other, while Guillermo struggles to balance his loyalty to Nandor with his desire to become a vampire, complicated by his ancestry as a descendant of vampire hunter Van Helsing. The series is the second television production in the franchise after the spin-off Wellington Paranormal (2018–2022), and both share the same canon as the original film, with characters from the film appearing, including Clement and Waititi. The show received critical acclaim, earning 35 Emmy Award nominations, including four for Outstanding Comedy Series in 2020, 2022, 2024, and 2025, for its second, third, fifth, and sixth seasons, respectively. A pilot order was announced on January 22, 2018, written by Clement and directed by Waititi, with Scott Rudin, Paul Simms, Garrett Basch, and Eli Bush also serving as executive producers. A series order for ten episodes was given on May 3, 2018, with the first season premiering on March 27, 2019. Principal photography for the first season took place from October 22 to December 18, 2018, in Toronto, Ontario, while filming for the third season occurred from February 8 to May 3, 2021. The second season premiered on April 15, 2020, followed by a third season on September 2, 2021, after a renewal on May 22, 2020; a fourth season was renewed on August 13, 2021, ahead of the third-season premiere; a fifth and sixth season were renewed on June 6, 2022, ahead of the fourth season premiere; and on December 19, 2023, it was announced that the sixth season would be the final one. Filming for the sixth and final season concluded in May 2024. The series does not use CGI effects, relying instead on in-camera techniques, such as a scene where Natasia Demetriou's character walks out from behind a tree during a park sequence. Cinematographers D.J. Stipsen and Christian Sprenger drew inspiration from Michael Ballhaus and Thomas E. Sanders' work on Bram Stoker's Dracula, aiming for a sumptuous yet neglected vampire mansion with faded colors, including strong reds and warm browns. The opening credits feature the song "You're Dead" by Norma Tanega (1966), used in the original film. The series held a panel at New York Comic Con on October 7, 2018, and had its world premiere at the 2019 South by Southwest film festival. All six seasons received critical acclaim: the overall series holds a 96% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a 83 out of 100 score on Metacritic. The first season has a 94% approval rating and an 80/100 Metacritic score; the second season has a 98% approval rating and a 79/100 score; the third season has a 100% approval rating and a 96/100 score; the fourth season has a 100% approval rating and an 84/100 score, though some critics criticized the reductive treatment of Nandor's wife, Marwa; the fifth season has a 95% approval rating and an 85/100 score; and the sixth season has a 91% approval rating and a 79/100 score. Nielsen Media Research reported that from June 1, 2024, to May 31, 2025, the series was streamed for a total of 55.6 million hours.
